Name: Texas Instruments Incorporated
Description: Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI), headquartered in Dallas, Texas, is a leading American technology company specializing in the design and manufacture of semiconductors and a broad range of integrated circuits. Renowned for its innovation and engineering excellence, TI services a diverse array of markets including automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics while maintaining a strong global presence as one of the top ten semiconductor companies by sales volume. The company’s commitment to research and development enables it to deliver high-performance solutions that empower customers to develop cutting-edge technologies and applications.
Address: 12500 TI BOULEVARD, DALLAS, TX, UNITED STATES, 75243
